definition: For each studio structure S (term plus its ZFA is_a/part_of descendants) and each pair of sources A,B: genes that A records as expressed in S AND that B has any call for (any anatomy). Of those, B_pos = B also records expression somewhere in S; B_neg = B asserts absence in S only (Bgee absent calls) with no presence; B_silent = B has calls for the gene but none in S (not recorded, not absence). agree_rate = B_pos / assessed. baseline_rate = the same B_pos rate among genes A has calls for but NOT in S (agreement means something only when agree_rate clearly exceeds baseline_rate). Bgee:Dr:non-ISH counts only Bgee calls backed by RNA-seq/Affymetrix/EST/scRNA, because Bgee imports ZFIN in situ data (ZFIN vs Bgee:Dr is therefore not independent). Bgee calls are restricted to structures observed directly (no propagation). Medaka/Astyanax rows reach zebrafish genes through OMA orthologs.
